chapter.heading: In My Distress I Cried to the LORDA song of ascents.
chapter.v:
In my
distress I cried to the LORD,and He answered me.

Deliver my
soul, O LORD,from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.

What will
He do to you,and what will be added to you,O deceitful tongue?

Sharp arrows
will come from the warrior,with burning coals of the broom tree!

Woe to
me that I dwell in Meshech,that I live among the tents of Kedar!

Too long
have I dweltamong those who hate peace.

I am
in favor of peace;but when I speak, they want war.
